messages.content: What is the record for the most points scored by a single player in an NBA game?

function.name: sports_data_basketball_most_points_single_season
function.description: Returns the record for the most points scored by a single player in one season of NBA, including the player name, points scored, and season. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

league.description: The specific basketball league for which to fetch the record. In this case, 'NBA'.

function.name: sports_data_basketball_most_points_career
function.description: Returns the record for the most points scored by a player in his career in NBA, including the player name, total points scored, and career span. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

league.description: The specific basketball league for which to fetch the record. In this case, 'NBA'.

league.description: The specific basketball league for which to fetch the record. In this case, 'NBA'.
